title: Keep cross-PC MAP links allowed by OpenSnitch
description: Add narrow, auditable OpenSnitch allow rules and an idempotent installer for KUDU cross-PC SSH authority and hcom relay traffic; preserve existing user rules, avoid opening inbound ports, and record verification.
acceptance_criteria: The SSH rule allows only /usr/bin/ssh traffic to RUKI at 192.168.1.153 and does not create an inbound firewall opening.
The hcom rule allows the exact installed hcom executable while accommodating dynamic relay broker addresses.
Installation is idempotent, preserves every unrelated OpenSnitch rule, and validates JSON before deployment.
OpenSnitch reloads the installed rules and both the MAP authority SSH path and hcom relay remain connected.
